title: Equality with LEAST by minimum characterisation for Harry's measure (IMO 2019 Q5)
intent: Prove that harry_meas xs is the least number of steps after which Harry's coin process leaves no heads, by the two-part minimum characterisation Least_equality: show the value satisfies the predicate, and show every other satisfying value is at least it. The two halves are already separate lemmas, so the glue is one line per obligation.

parent.name: harry_meas_eq_LEAST
parent.statement: harry_meas xs = (LEAST n. True \<notin> set ((harry_step ^^ n) xs))
parent.note: The theorem is anonymous in the source (theorem "..." with no name); harry_meas_eq_LEAST is the analyst's name for it.

children.name: True_in_funpow_harry_step
children.statement:
lemma True_in_funpow_harry_step:
  assumes "n < harry_meas xs"
  shows   "True \<in> set ((harry_step ^^ n) xs)"
children.closed_by: induction n arbitrary: xs; 0 case by (rule ccontr) (use 0 in auto); Suc case by (intro Suc) (auto simp: harry_meas_step)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: if n < harry_meas xs then the n-th iterate of harry_step still contains a head

children.name: True_notin_funpow_harry_step
children.statement: lemma True_notin_funpow_harry_step: "True \<notin> set ((harry_step ^^ harry_meas xs) xs)"
children.closed_by: induction harry_meas xs arbitrary: xs; base by auto; Suc case by (intro Suc) (auto simp: harry_meas_step)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the harry_meas xs-th iterate of harry_step contains no head

applicability.goal_shape: An equality x = (LEAST n. P n) over a nat-valued measure, where P n says the n-th iterate of a step function reaches a terminal state (here, no heads left in the coin sequence).
applicability.use_when: You already have the two halves as named lemmas — a satisfying-value lemma (P x) and a lower-bound lemma (every y satisfying P is at least x) — so the proof is one line per Least_equality obligation.
applicability.avoid_when: The least-element argument needs a nontrivial witness construction (then the witness lemma is the content, not the characterisation); you want an iff or an order antisymmetry between two terms rather than a LEAST; or the predicate is over a type without a well-order, where LEAST and the two-part rule are unavailable.

consequences: The move turns one goal into the two obligations of Least_equality: (1) the candidate value satisfies the predicate, (2) every satisfying value is a lower bound. Each obligation becomes one child, discharged by one project lemma each. The minimality direction (2) is proved by contradiction using the satisfying-value direction of the sibling lemma (True_in_funpow_harry_step), so the two children are not independent: minimality rides on the lower-bound direction's contrapositive. Failure mode: if the two directions were not already stated as separate lemmas, the glue would carry inline proofs and the characterisation would collapse into a single proof.
